answer: An auditor would note that a farm's masks all drift toward one treasury. Admission issues each identity a custody claim on a reef: every epoch the tide moves the claim to a random umber stratum, and the holder retrieves it only by proving a fresh signature sealed with that stratum's local state. A reef register logs each leg of the migration; a claim parked across many identities fails retrieval. A farm must shepherd a thousand claims across a thousand strata each round; an honest agent walks one claim and signs once.
